thread:
Alex (AE): OrionBank just escalated to their CIO / procurement. They put the POC on hold until we provide: (A) BYO-KMS attestation + step-by-step onboarding timeline, (B) a named set of static egress IPs and an ops cutover plan, (C) a short p95 latency commitment for inference. Execs are pushing for a written trial credit offer to present at their meeting tomorrow. Need a quick coordinated response. :warning:

Priya (SE): I ran a quick repro from their jump host; TLS handshakes intermittently fail when routed through their corporate proxy (RST after TLS client_hello). Minimal repro:
```
curl -Iv --resolve api.redwood.example:443:52.86.11.9 https://api.redwood.example/health
# observed: SYN/ACK then RST from proxy after ~12s
```

Priya (SE): Short fix options: 1) provide static egress IPs + private-link so traffic avoids their DPI; 2) spin up a short Dedicated sandbox in their region to guarantee egress origin.

Nadia (Security): We can produce a one-page BYOK attestation and BYOK runbook (AWS KMS + external HSM) within 24h. Legal will need a limited DPA amendment for key audit logs — I can draft that. I'll bundle SOC2 and pen-test excerpts. Lina, can you start the security questionnaire and ask the CISO to mark the gate items?

Ethan (Infra): For a p95 <= 200ms commitment, a dedicated sandbox with private-link in their region is the reliable option. Estimate: 3-node pool for 14 days -> raw infra ~ $6k/day. Static egress IPs we can reserve: 52.86.11.9, 52.86.11.10, 52.86.11.11. I can spin up a 14-day sandbox now if we authorize credits.

Sam (Head of Sales): Proposal: offer a 14-day dedicated sandbox + BYOK onboarding assistance + private-link. Ask for a 12-month reserved conversion if they convert within 30 days of trial end. Recommend approving up to $45k in trial credits to close the exec ask. Need revops/legal signoff for the credit cap and expedited DPA review.

Lina (CS): I'll open the questionnaire and request a CISO call tomorrow AM. I'll prepare a 1-pager showing the BYOK flow, network options, and the allowlist snippet for their ops team.

legal-bot: legal note: DPA addendum required for key custody/audit access. Legal can fast-track if AE confirms the revenue motion (12-mo commit) and credit cap.

Alex (AE): Action items:
- @Lina: schedule CISO call + kickoff questionnaire.
- @Nadia: share BYOK attestation + list DPA changes.
- @Ethan: confirm cost for 7/14/30 day trials and final credit ask.
- @Sam: confirm credit cap approval path with revops.

Alex (AE): Exec question: do we approve up to $45k in trial credits and expedited legal review of the DPA addendum to unblock OrionBank? Need decision within 12 hours or they will pause the POC. :hourglass:
